newsitem.title: HONG KONG: W.I. Carr derivatives trader sacked - papers.
newsitem.headline: W.I. Carr derivatives trader sacked - papers.

text.p: W.I. Carr's head of equity-derivatives trading, Magnus Eriksson, has been sacked, newspapers reported on Tuesday.

The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong said it was looking into unusual share market activity last Thursday and market sources said W.I. Carr was one of the six brokerage houses being asked to explain trades that day.
W.I. Carr was not immediately available for comment.
Eriksson, who was a managing director at the firm, lost up to US$6 million last Thursday trading equity derivatives, the South China Morning Post said.
The Hang Seng Index surged 213 points to a record of 13,744.30 in the first 15 minutes of trade last Thursday but closed the day down 220.19 points at 13,310.76.
